feeds.title: Part-time Working Hockey Mom
feeds.description: I'm Tamara. Follow my daily life journey as a hockey mom. I do parenting, crafts, baking, holidays, parties, ice hockey, and other fun stuff through my blog.

feeds.title: Elite Level Hockey » Elite Hockey Moms
feeds.description: Elite Hockey Moms offer tips for minor hockey parents on how to organize off-ice team meals, hotel stays and other advice on living the hockey dream. Elite Level Hockey promotes the positives of the minor hockey lifestyle by sharing the experiences of players, parents, coaches, scouts and former pros in the hopes that their stories will inspire, enlighten and educate about the game we love.

feeds.title: Nebraska Hockey Mom
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Tonya! I am a middle school teaching mom of 4 hockey players, aged from 9 to 18! We LIVE at the ice rink! I designed this blog as a hobby for people to see real life...life at the ice rink...and have reviews and giveaways!

feeds.title: Ghockeymom's Blog
feeds.description: Follow my journey through life as a hockey mom in this blog.

feeds.title: Syracuse Hockey Mom's Network
feeds.description: This is a documentation of the journey of a hockey mom and author (children's book, The Puck Hog). We are building a network of moms and dads who share the common goal of building kids with good hockey skills and good character.

feeds.title: Hockey Rivals Books Blog
feeds.description: Hockey Rivals Books hockey blog geared toward families whose kids play or follow hockey. Sportsbooks for kids, hockey gift ideas, resources, and more. Blog author Stacy Juba is a published author of multiple novels and stories that involve or focus on the sport of Hockey.

feeds.title: The Hockey Mom Fit Life Blog
feeds.description: Explore my Adventures in motherhood, fitness, youth hockey & corporate America. My mission is to match you with the best fitness regimen for your lifestyle. Getting healthy is a lifestyle change that needs to be fun in order to be sustainable.

feeds.title: Canadian Hockey moms Blog
feeds.description: If you love your hockey loving child, this is the place for you. Welcome to the most engaged and engaging community of Hockey Moms in the world! I share my children's hockey stories along with my fellow hockey mom stories in this blog. I have three hockey playing children (two boys and a girl) and I started Canadian Hockey Moms in February of 2010 during the Vancouver winter Olympics.

feeds.title: Infamous Hockey blog » Hockey moms
feeds.description: Explore this section to know more about how to manage your young hockey child. Infamous Hockey is a hockey company focused on delivering high quality hockey sticks and apparel for the elite youth hockey player.
